title: Watching the Watchers: Exposing Gender Disparities in Machine Translation Quality Estimation

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing Quality Estimation (QE) metrics on minimal-edit contrastive translation pairs featuring masculine, feminine, and gender-neutral inflections. The evaluation measures the ratio of QE scores assigned to different gender forms and calculates the error rate when metrics must select the correct translation inflection based on ambiguous or unambiguous contextual cues.
